data: How many different constituent heights are plotted for unbiased trees derived from the syntactic task distances in the model?

The top graph shows the accuracy breakdown of constituent heights for unbiased trees derived from the syntactic task distances in the model. The x-axis represents the constituent heights, ranging from 0 to 27. The y-axis represents the accuracy. Each bar corresponds to a different constituent height, and there are 28 distinct bars, indicating 28 different constituent heights. Therefore, the number of different constituent heights plotted is 28.
